title: COMPARATIVE/FUNCTIONAL VERTEBRATE ANATOMY
description: Phylogenetically-based study of the form and function of vertebrate organ systems, including integumentary, musculoskeletal, cardiopulmonary, digestive, and sensory. Lab emphasizes comparative form through dissection, and function through non-invasive experimentation.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ((BI 221Z or 221HZ) and (BI 222Z or 222HZ) and (BI 223Z or 223HZ)) or ((BI 221 or 221H) and (BI 222 or 222H) and (BI 223 or 223H)) and (CH 332*, 332H* or 335*).
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BI 221Z, BI 221HZ, BI 222Z, BI 222HZ, BI 223Z, BI 223HZ, BI 221, BI 221H, BI 222, BI 222H, BI 223 and BI 223H.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CH 332, CH 332H and CH 335.
meeting_html: R 2pm-4:50pm in CORD 1518 - Cordley Hall 1518 (9/23 to 12/4)
